data.name: Aynul
data.gender_notes: Aynul is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘ayn’ (eye), Aynul symbolizes the one who has insight, knowledge, and vision. In Islamic history, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) was given the title ‘Aynul Hawa’ (the one who has the most knowledge of the unseen), emphasizing the importance of knowledge and wisdom. The name Aynul carries the meaning “The One with the Eye” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aynul usually hope their child will grow to embody the one with the eye and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aynul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One with the Eye.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aynul total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_urdu.name: عینول
in_urdu.meaning: عینول کا مطلب ہے آنکھ کی روشنی، خیر اور برکت کا دہنہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عینول ایک مسلم نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے. اس کا مطلب ہے آنکھ کی روشنی، خیر اور برکت کا دہنہ. یہ نام ان شخصیتوں کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنی بصیرت اور فطری ذہانت کے لئے جانے جاتے ہیں. اسلامی تقالید میں، یہ نام اچھے اور محمود معانی کا حامل ہے.

in_hindi.name: अयनुल
in_hindi.meaning: अयनुल का अर्थ है आंखों की रोशनी, अच्छाई और आशीर्वाद का प्रतीक
